My dear [Miss Butler](../persons.html#237),
Two lines to say that here I am at home, & shall be delighted to have [Likes & Dislikes](../others.html#248) if they are ready. I go to [Dogd](../others.html#121) on Monday week, but if I could have them in the interval, I should be glad.

But I am afraid it is of no use to try for two chapters in [one number](../others.html#52) I am engaged to so much, I have been reading Peothès[^1] in English and delighting in him.

In great haste

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: The librarian confirms that the word looks like Peothes, but no explanation can be offered.
